snippet.title: Schnudergoof – Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Give in to demonic desires. Swallow our humours. Eat god on display. Snuffle during a hot winter. This is a lovesong like you and me and we sing and kiss just like it used to be in the twilight yesterdays they never came to see. 
The boyfriend you wished for is on his way.
